items.t: GTA 6 Just Sold an Estimated $2.36 Billion in One Day, Nearly Triple GTA V. Take-Two Stock Is Rising
items.sum: Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto VI sold 24.6 million digital copies worth about $2.36 billion through its first day, nearly three times GTA V's first day and above the $1.9 billion Bank of America said the game needed in three days. Take-Two has not confirmed a number.

items.t: Take-Two (TTWO) Sees $14.5 Million in Net ETF Buying on Wednesday
items.sum: ETFs bought $14.5 million of Take-Two stock on Wednesday, Nov. 18.
